correctness.rationale: PGL3(k) flag transitivity, scaling of the nonzero Y²Z tangent coefficient and exactly seven unrestricted cubic coefficients prove exhaustive normal form for every cubic with at least one smooth k-point; curves without such points have no tangents. The C++ code checks 9^7=4,782,969 normalized cubics by exact 9-element field tables and bitwise union of lines, yielding maximum 85 and no full covers. A separately implemented Python point-incidence computation checks the explicit 16-point smooth maximizer and all 91 incidences; elementary conic bounds and the known quartic witness give minimum four.
